name: Can you paint directly over peeling paint or bathroom mildew?

mainEntity.name: Can you paint directly over peeling paint or bathroom mildew?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should not paint directly over bathroom mold or peeling paint. Applying fresh paint over active mold or loose, flaking layers traps moisture underneath, which causes the new paint to bubble and allows fungus to spread. Before any color goes on the wall, HH Remodeling scrapes away peeling layers, treats surface mildew, and patches or replaces damaged drywall sections. Once the substrate is clean, dry, and sanded flat, applying a dedicated moisture-sealing primer creates a stable foundation that prevents future peeling and stops old stains from bleeding through.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. All peeling paint must be scraped away, mildew cleaned, and damaged drywall repaired before priming and painting to ensure a lasting bond.
